items.name: Kraków Open 2013

venue.name: [Wydzial Fizyki, Matematyki i Informatyki Politechniki Krakowskiej](http://www.fmi.pk.edu.pl)

items.information: Registration fee is 15 PLN. Limit of competitors is 60. Registration starts 28th April and ends 10th May. Registration fee must be paid before 12th May on bank account or by PayPal (more information on Competition website). If someone resign he may request of refunding registration fee, but only before 12th May.

items.name: Newark Head to Head 2013

venue.name: [The Newark Public Library](http://www.npl.org/)
venue.details: Centennial Hall, on the second floor

items.information: The second round of 3x3x3 will be held as a head to head battle. The competitors with the top 32 averages from round 1 will move on, and will continue to round two where they will compete one on one until a winner is found. The top 8 single times from the first solve of the head-to-head will determine who moves onto the final round of the official 3x3x3 competition. Only the first solve of the head-to-head will be official. The remainder of the head-to-head competition will be unofficial and for entertainment purposes.
